```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Load the Libraries
```{r, message = FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(permute)
library(devtools)
library(ape)
library(Biostrings)
library(usethis)
library(qiime2R)
library(tidyverse) # Loads ggplot2, dplyr, etc.
library(vegan)
library(ggtree)# For tree plotting
library(RColorBrewer)
library(genefilter)
library(treeio)
library(pheatmap)
```
Import data and create phyloseq object

```{r}

otu_table_silva <- read.delim("phyloseq-export/feature-table/asv-table.tsv", skip=1, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)

otu_table_silva_matrix <-as.matrix(otu_table_silva)

OTU_SILVA<- otu_table(otu_table_silva_matrix, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
cat("OTU table loaded. Dimensions:", dim(OTU_SILVA), "\n")

taxonomy_silva<-read.delim("phyloseq-export/taxonomy/taxonomy.tsv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1, sep='\t')

taxonomy_silva_split <- str_split_fixed(taxonomy_silva$Taxon, ";", n=7)
colnames(taxonomy_silva_split) <-c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
# Remove the 'd__', 'p__', etc. prefixes
# Apply this function to each column of the matrix
taxonomy_silva_split_clean <- apply(taxonomy_silva_split, 2, function(x) gsub("^[dkpcofgs]__", "", x))
# Ensure row names (Feature IDs) match the original taxonomy data frame
rownames(taxonomy_silva_split_clean) <- rownames(taxonomy_silva)

OLD_NAME <- "Candidatus_Eremiobacterota"
NEW_NAME <- "Eremiobacterota"

# Find all instances of the old name in the Phylum column and replace them
taxonomy_silva_split_clean[
  taxonomy_silva_split_clean[, "Phylum"] == OLD_NAME,
  "Phylum"
] <- NEW_NAME

TAX_SILVA<-tax_table(taxonomy_silva_split_clean)
cat("Taxonomy table loaded. Dimensions:", dim(TAX_SILVA), "\n")

sample_data<-read.delim('phyloseq-export/metadata/sample-metadata.tsv', header=TRUE, row.names = 1, sep='\t')
# 'replicate_group' as factor
sample_data$replicate <- as.factor(sample_data$replicate)
META <- sample_data(sample_data)
cat("Sample metadata loaded. Number of samples:", nsamples(META), "\n")

seqs_dna_string_set_silva <- readDNAStringSet("phyloseq-export/sequences/dna-sequences.fasta")
REFSEQ_SILVA <- refseq(seqs_dna_string_set_silva)
cat("Representative sequences loaded. Number of sequences:", length(REFSEQ_SILVA), "\n")

# Load Phylogenetic Tree
tree_silva <- read.tree("phyloseq-export/tree/tree.nwk")
TREE_SILVA <- phy_tree(tree_silva)
cat("Phylogenetic tree loaded. Number of tips:", length(tree_silva$tip.label), "\n")

#Phyloseq construction

ps_silva <- phyloseq(OTU_SILVA, TAX_SILVA, META, REFSEQ_SILVA, TREE_SILVA)
```





Filtering step for Kingdom and Phylum:
```{r}
unique(tax_table(ps_silva)[, "Kingdom"])
table(tax_table(ps_silva)[, "Kingdom"], exclude = NULL)
table(tax_table(ps_silva)[, "Phylum"], exclude = NULL)
ps_silva_phylum <- subset_taxa(ps_silva, !is.na(Phylum) & !Phylum %in% c(""))
table(tax_table(ps_silva_phylum)[, "Phylum"], exclude = NULL)

```

Taxonomy Bar Plots
```{r}
# Transform to relative abundance
ps_rel_abund <- transform_sample_counts(ps_silva_phylum, function(x) x / sum(x))

# Top 10 phyla
top_n_phyla_count <- 10

# Identify the names of the top N most abundant phyla
top_phyla_names <- names(sort(tapply(taxa_sums(ps_rel_abund), tax_table(ps_rel_abund)[,"Phylum"], sum), decreasing=TRUE))[1:top_n_phyla_count]
top_phyla_names

# Convert the phyloseq object to a long format data frame for ggplot2
# Aggregate to Phylum level before melting for cleaner "Other" grouping
plot_data_phylum <- ps_rel_abund %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Phylum") %>% # Aggregate to Phylum level
  psmelt()

# Assign "Other" to phyla that are not in the top 10
plot_data_phylum$Phylum <- ifelse(plot_data_phylum$Phylum %in% top_phyla_names,
                                  plot_data_phylum$Phylum,
                                  "Other")

# Reorder phylum levels 
# Put "Other" at the end of the levels
plot_data_phylum$Phylum <- factor(plot_data_phylum$Phylum,
                                  levels = c(top_phyla_names, "Other"))
# new names in the same order as sample_names(ps_rel_abund)
new_sample_names <- c("Bark-1", "Bark-2", "Bark-3") 

# Replace the Sample column in plot_data_phylum
plot_data_phylum$Sample <- new_sample_names[match(plot_data_phylum$Sample, sample_names(ps_rel_abund))]

# Define a color palette

num_colors_needed <- top_n_phyla_count + 1
my_phylum_colors <- c(brewer.pal(min(top_n_phyla_count, 11), "Set3"), "grey50") # Use Set3 up to 11, then add grey for Other. Adjust if top_n_phyla_count > 11.
if (top_n_phyla_count > 11) { # Fallback for more colors
  my_phylum_colors <- c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(top_n_phyla_count), "grey50")
}

my_phylum_colors <- brewer.pal(n = length(unique(plot_data_phylum$Phylum)), 
                                name = "Set3")

# Create the bar plot
p_taxa_barplot <- ggplot(plot_data_phylum, aes(x=Sample, y=Abundance, fill=Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack", color="black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.8) + # Add thin black border for definition
  labs(
    x = "Sample ID",
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill = "Phylum") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     breaks = seq (0, 1, 0.25),
                     labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0001, 0))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.6,0.6))
  )+
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family="sans") + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, colour="black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.line = element_line(colour="black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, colour="black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), # Remove vertical grid lines
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11, margin = margin(r = 8)),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "mm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, colour="black", face="bold"),
    legend.key.size=unit(4, "mm")
)
    
print(p_taxa_barplot)



ggsave("taxa_barplot_publication_phylum_SILVA.pdf", 
       plot = p_taxa_barplot,
       width = 180,    # mm (journal column width)
       height = 120, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 300)

# High-resolution PNG (raster format - for presentations)
ggsave("taxa_barplot_publication_phylum_SILVA.png", 
       plot = p_taxa_barplot,
       width = 180,
       height = 120,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 600)  

```

```{r}

# Calculate total abundance per phylum across all samples
phylum_abundance <- ps_rel_abund %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Phylum") %>%
  taxa_sums()

# Get taxonomy table for phyla
phylum_tax <- tax_table(tax_glom(ps_rel_abund, taxrank = "Phylum"))

# Match abundances to phylum names
phylum_totals <- tapply(phylum_abundance, phylum_tax[, "Phylum"], sum)
top_phyla_names <- names(sort(phylum_totals, decreasing = TRUE))[1:top_n_phyla_count]

cat("\nTop", top_n_phyla_count, "phyla by abundance:\n")
print(round(sort(phylum_totals, decreasing = TRUE)[1:top_n_phyla_count] * 100, 2))


# --- 9. Create Summary Table ---
# Abundance table for top phyla per sample
abundance_table <- plot_data_phylum %>%
  group_by(Sample, Phylum) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(Phylum)

cat("\n=== Phylum Abundance Table (Relative) ===\n")
print(abundance_table, n = Inf)

# Export table
write.csv(abundance_table, "phylum_abundance_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# --- 10. Calculate Summary Statistics ---
phylum_stats <- plot_data_phylum %>%
  filter(Phylum != "Other") %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(
    Mean_Abundance = mean(Abundance),
    SD = sd(Abundance),
    Min = min(Abundance),
    Max = max(Abundance),
    CV = (sd(Abundance) / mean(Abundance)) * 100  # Coefficient of variation
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_Abundance))

cat("\n=== Phylum Summary Statistics ===\n")
print(phylum_stats, n = Inf)

write.csv(phylum_stats, "phylum_summary_statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}

# --- 2. Get Top Classes ---
top_n_classes <- 12  # Reasonable number for legend readability

# Collapse to class level
ps_class <- tax_glom(ps_rel_abund_class, taxrank = "Class")

# Calculate total abundance per class
class_abundance <- taxa_sums(ps_class)
class_tax <- tax_table(ps_class)[, "Class"]
class_totals <- tapply(class_abundance, class_tax, sum)

# Get top class names
top_class_names <- names(sort(class_totals, decreasing = TRUE))[1:top_n_classes]

cat("Top", top_n_classes, "classes represent:",
    round(sum(class_totals[top_class_names]) * 100, 1), "% of total abundance\n\n")

# --- 3. Prepare Plot Data ---
plot_data <- psmelt(ps_class)

# Categorize as top classes or "Other"
plot_data$Class <- ifelse(
  plot_data$Class %in% top_class_names,
  plot_data$Class,
  "Other"
)

# Rename samples
plot_data$Sample <- factor(
  plot_data$Sample,
  levels = unique(plot_data$Sample),
  labels = c("Bark-1", "Bark-2", "Bark-3")
)

# Order classes by mean abundance
class_order <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Class != "Other") %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  summarize(mean_abund = mean(Abundance)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
  pull(Class)

plot_data$Class <- factor(
  plot_data$Class,
  levels = c(class_order, "Other")
)

# Calculate "Other" percentage
other_summary <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Class == "Other") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarize(Other_pct = sum(Abundance) * 100)

cat("'Other' category per sample:\n")
print(other_summary)
cat("\n")

# --- 4. Color Palette ---
# Simple, colorblind-friendly palette
my_colors <- c(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set3"))(top_n_classes),
  "grey70"
)
names(my_colors) <- levels(plot_data$Class)

# --- 5. Create Publication-Quality Barplot ---
p_class <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = "stack", 
           color = "black", 
           linewidth = 0.2,
           width = 0.75) +
  
  # Y-axis as percentages
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  
  # X-axis
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill = "Class"
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    # Axes
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "mm"),
    
    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    
    # Panel
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    
    # Margins
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10, "mm"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

print(p_class)

# --- 6. Save High-Quality Outputs ---
ggsave("class_barplot_publication_SILVA_2.pdf", p_class,
       width = 180, height = 130, units = "mm", dpi = 300)

ggsave("class_barplot_publication_SILVA_2.png", p_class,
       width = 180, height = 130, units = "mm", dpi = 600)

# --- 7. Export Abundance Table ---
abundance_table <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Sample, Class, Phylum) %>%
  summarize(Percentage = sum(Abundance) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(Phylum, desc(rowSums(select(., -Class, -Phylum))))

write.csv(abundance_table, "class_abundance_table_SILVA.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("=== Class Abundance Table (with Phylum) ===\n")
print(abundance_table, n = 20)

# --- 8. Summary Statistics ---
class_stats <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Class, Phylum) %>%
  summarize(
    Mean_pct = mean(Abundance) * 100,
    SD_pct = sd(Abundance) * 100,
    Min_pct = min(Abundance) * 100,
    Max_pct = max(Abundance) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_pct))

write.csv(class_stats, "class_summary_statistics_SILVA.csv", row.names = FALSE)


cat("\n=== Class Summary Statistics ===\n")
print(class_stats, n = 20)

# --- 9. Summary Report ---
cat("\n", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("CLASS-LEVEL ANALYSIS SUMMARY\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("\nTotal classes detected:", length(unique(plot_data$Class)) - 1, "\n")
cat("Top", top_n_classes, "classes shown (+ Other category)\n")
cat("\nFiles generated:\n")
cat("  - class_barplot_publication.pdf/png\n")
cat("  - class_abundance_table.csv\n")
cat("  - class_summary_statistics.csv\n")
cat(rep("=", 60), "\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
# --- OPTIONAL: Faceted plot by top phyla ---
top_5_phyla <- names(sort(tapply(
  taxa_sums(ps_rel_abund_class), 
  tax_table(ps_rel_abund_class)[, "Phylum"], 
  sum
), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]

plot_data_facet <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% top_5_phyla, Class != "Other") %>%
  mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum, levels = top_5_phyla))

p_class_faceted <- ggplot(plot_data_facet, 
                          aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", 
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Phylum, nrow = 1) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative Abundance (%)") +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family="sans") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9, colour="black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size =9, colour="black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=11, colour = "black", margin = margin(r=8)),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "mm"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, colour="black", face="bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, colour="black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), # Remove vertical grid lines
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
     axis.line = element_line(colour="black", linewidth = 0.5)
  )
print(p_class_faceted)

ggsave("class_by_phylum_faceted_SILVA.pdf", p_class_faceted,
       width = 250, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
ggsave("class_by_phylum_faceted_SILVA.png", p_class_faceted,
       width = 180, height = 130, units = "mm", dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
# Collapse at desired level (e.g., Phylum)
ps_phylum <- tax_glom(ps_rel_abund, taxrank = "Phylum")

# Melt into long format
df_phylum <- psmelt(ps_phylum)

# Summarize relative abundance per sample (convert to %)
phylum_table <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(Sample, Phylum) %>%
  summarize(Percentage = sum(Abundance) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Save to CSV
write.csv(phylum_table, "phylum_percentages.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(phylum_table, n = Inf)

# Summarize mean ± SD across samples
phylum_summary <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(
    Mean = mean(Abundance) * 100,          # mean %
    SD   = sd(Abundance) * 100,            # standard deviation
    Min  = min(Abundance) * 100,           # minimum
    Max  = max(Abundance) * 100,           # maximum
    CV   = (sd(Abundance) / mean(Abundance)) * 100,  # coefficient of variation
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean))

write.csv(phylum_summary, "phylum_summary_mean_sd.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(phylum_summary, n = Inf)


```

```{r}
    CV   = (sd(Abundance) / mean(Abundance)) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean))

write.csv(class_summary_2, "class_summary_mean_sd.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(class_summary_2, n = Inf)
```

```{r}


# Extract the taxonomy table and OTU table from your phyloseq object
tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_silva_class))
otu_table_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_silva_class))

# Identify methanotroph taxa (Methylovirgula and Methylocapsa)
methanotroph_genera <- c("Methylovirgula", "Methylocapsa")
methanotroph_taxa <- rownames(tax_table_df)[tax_table_df$Genus %in% methanotroph_genera]

cat("Number of methanotroph ASVs/OTUs found:", length(methanotroph_taxa), "\n")
if(length(methanotroph_taxa) > 0) {
  cat("Methanotroph genera present:\n")
  print(table(tax_table_df[methanotroph_taxa, "Genus"]))
}

# Calculate total reads per sample
total_reads <- colSums(otu_table_df)

# Calculate methanotroph reads per sample
if(length(methanotroph_taxa) > 0) {
  # If only one methanotroph taxon, convert to matrix to avoid dimension issues
  methanotroph_reads <- colSums(otu_table_df[methanotroph_taxa, , drop = FALSE])
} else {
  methanotroph_reads <- rep(0, ncol(otu_table_df))
  names(methanotroph_reads) <- colnames(otu_table_df)
}

# Calculate percentage
methanotroph_percentage <- (methanotroph_reads / total_reads) * 100

# Create results data frame
results_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(methanotroph_percentage),
  Total_Reads = total_reads,
  Methanotroph_Reads = methanotroph_reads,
  Methanotroph_Percentage = methanotroph_percentage
)

# Display results
cat("\n=== Methanotroph Abundance Results ===\n")
print(results_df)

# Summary statistics
cat("\nSummary of methanotroph percentages across samples:\n")
print(summary(results_df$Methanotroph_Percentage))

```


```{r}

alpha_metrics <- estimate_richness(ps_silva, measures=c("Observed", "Shannon", "Faith_PD"))
alpha_metrics


alpha_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_silva), alpha_metrics)

p_shannon <- ggplot(alpha_df, aes(x=replicate, y=Shannon)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.3, outlier.shape = NA) + # Boxplot (outlier.shape=NA to handle points separately)
  geom_jitter(width=0.1, height=0, alpha=0.8, size=3, aes(color=replicate)) + # Show individual points
  labs(
    x="Replicate Group",
    y="Shannon Diversity Index",
    title="Alpha Diversity (Shannon Index)"
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") + # Use a color palette for points
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # Hide legend as x-axis provides info
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold") # Make group label bold
  )

print(p_shannon)
ggsave("alpha_diversity_shannon.png", p_shannon, width=6, height=5, dpi=300)
ggsave("alpha_diversity_shannon.pdf", p_shannon, width=6, height=5)


p_observed <- ggplot(alpha_df, aes(x=replicate, y=Observed)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.1, height=0, alpha=0.8, size=3, aes(color=replicate)) +
  labs(
    x="Replicate Group",
    y="Observed ASVs",
    title="Alpha Diversity (Observed ASVs)"
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_observed)
ggsave("alpha_diversity_observed_SILVA.png", p_observed, width=6, height=5, dpi=300)
ggsave("alpha_diversity_observed_SILVA.pdf", p_observed, width=6, height=5)




```
